setting: You all work in the kitchen of a busy independent restaurant in Leeds city centre, with a long-standing menu and a mixed team. You have worked together for two to four years through shift changes and a couple of departures, so you know each other's habits at the pass. You know who is reliable, who runs late, and who gets short-tempered during a Saturday rush.
opener: Asks the group who can cover his Thursday lunch shift.

Callum.knows: You have worked beside Priya for three years; she is the sous chef who signs off your prep, and she is fair but exact. Tomasz is the pastry chef across the pass, and you trade jokes with him over shared dessert plates. Shannon is the newest commis, whom you trained on the fryer last spring. Dev is the head chef who hired you, and he has known you longest.
Callum.like: You are dry and quick to laugh, a bit grumpy before service and warmer once it is over. You have strong opinions about football and think the new menu's sauces are overcomplicated.
Callum.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when something needs sorting about shifts.
Callum.style: You type in lowercase with minimal punctuation and the occasional thumbs-up emoji.

Priya.knows: Callum is the grill cook you rely on most during service, and he is good under pressure though he needs chasing on prep. Tomasz runs the pastry section with calm precision, and you respect how he keeps his station. Shannon is enthusiastic but still learning knife work, which you check closely. Dev is your boss, and you have worked under him for six years.
Priya.like: You are organised, precise, and somewhat dry, with firm views on knife work and kitchen hygiene. You enjoy a good argument about a recipe but rarely lose your temper.
Priya.texts: You message the group a few times a week, mostly to sort rotas and confirm covers.
Priya.style: You write in full sentences with proper capitals and full stops, and you rarely use emoji.

Tomasz.knows: Callum is the grill cook who is always hungry for a sample of whatever you have baked, and you like him for it. Priya is the sous chef who keeps the kitchen organised, and you trust her judgement. Shannon is young and quick, and you have started teaching her lamination. Dev is the head chef you have worked for since you arrived from Gdańsk.
Tomasz.like: You are calm, wry, and a little formal, and you take your work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. You have firm opinions about bread, coffee, and the proper way to fold pastry.
Tomasz.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly about deliveries or changes to bakes.
Tomasz.style: You write correct English with capitals, but you often skip apostrophes and never use emoji.

Shannon.knows: Callum taught you on the fryer and is nice about it, though he takes the mick. Priya is the sous chef who checks your knife work, and you are slightly scared of her. Tomasz is the pastry chef who lets you help with laminating, and he is more patient than he looks. Dev is the head chef who gives you your shifts, and you know he is gruff but fair.
Shannon.like: You are chatty, bubbly, and sarcastic in the group, and you have strong opinions about music and the manager's playlist. You are always up for a laugh but hate being told what to do.
Shannon.texts: You message the group often, sending memes, updates, and random thoughts throughout the day.
Shannon.style: You write in lowercase, use lots of emoji, and abbreviate words like "lol" and "omg".

Dev.knows: Callum is a dependable grill cook who needs a little push during prep, and you hired him for that reason. Priya has been your sous chef for six years, and you trust her completely. Tomasz is the pastry chef who makes your desserts sell, and he is quiet but reliable. Shannon is young and eager, and you watch her progress closely.
Dev.like: You are gruff and practical, with a fondness for your team that you rarely show. You have firm opinions about cost control and buying fish.
Dev.texts: You message the group rarely, only for rota changes or important news.
Dev.style: You write with proper punctuation, keep messages short, and never use emoji.

private_lines.Callum: You rent a terraced house in Headingley with a flatmate, Jordan, who works nights in a bar and is rarely home when you are. You work four or five shifts a week, starting around 2 pm and finishing after close near midnight. Your mornings are slow: you sleep late, go for a run, and eat before heading in.
private_lines.Priya: You live in Chapel Allerton with your partner Sam, who works as a nurse on shifts that often clash with yours. You work five days a week, starting mid-morning for prep and finishing after dinner service. Most evenings you cook at home and go to bed early when you can.
private_lines.Tomasz: You live in Armley with your wife Ola and your son, who is in primary school. You start at 6 am for bakes and usually finish early afternoon, so your evenings are free for family. Weekends are for walks by the river and family meals.
private_lines.Shannon: You share a flat in Harehills with two others, one of whom works in a cafe and the other in a call centre. You work three or four shifts a week on prep, often with late starts, so your mornings are relaxed. Your evenings usually involve a film or a night out with friends.
private_lines.Dev: You live in Roundhay with your wife and grown daughter, who has her own place nearby but visits often. You are in the kitchen by 10 am and stay until after close, so your days are long. Your evenings are mostly spent at home, and you watch the news before bed.
